title: The app slice of the legal document agent in shadow: the service login, the run-start path, the parameter codes and the by-case legal-action read, the two added event names, the feature flag, the missing S4 contract row and the route path are not fixed by any source
source: Legacy RWB-E2-030 sections 3, 4, 7, 11, 12 and 13; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.9; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1, T3.2, T5.2, T6.2 and T-A.1 to T-A.2; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13, 16, 41, 42, 43 and 44; Ownership Map v1 (eight agent tables owner P10, eleven P10 operations, EV-28 owner P10, AgentRunWorkflow owner P10, document and document_checklist_item owner P5, legal_action owner S4); Template and Rules v1 §R3, §R4, §R5.5, §R7.3 and §R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 5 Exception paths; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1, AC4 and AC7; 10 Authority; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.2; 12.8; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: Eight values the app slice needs are absent or unresolved in the sources. (1) The per-service login of rwb-agent is required by the naming rule and by the legacy section 3, which names only the agent identity and its environment equivalents; no source names the login of the service. (2) The legacy story calls an in-process harness and names no run-start operation, so no source gives the path below the base of `/api/recovery/agent/v1`. (3) The parameter keys the promotion check reads are not named, although the minimum scored sample and the promotion conditions move to rwb-case under DP-06. (4) The legal action is S4's under the Ownership Map and the legacy read is in-process, so the by-case read is an operation of rwb-litigation that no source names, and the key's C list carries no S4 contract story. (5) The event catalogue names only EV-28 AgentRunCompleted on the agent topic, so a started event and a pack-proposal event have no catalogued name. (6) The legacy feature flag `rwb.agent.legal-shadow` has no target owner, since feature flags move to the platform library under the default ruling. (7) The checklist the story reads was a legacy reference table; the Ownership Map makes `document_checklist_item` a P5 table, so the source of the read and its operation are unstated. (8) The gateway-bff route in front of the two operations has no name and no path. The story keeps the legacy behaviour and settles each value as an assumption.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-030 section 3 ('RWB-E1-058 is done: platform, sample loader and evaluation harness'), section 4 ('RW-COE: loads sample "LEGAL-S1" and starts the evaluation of "LEGAL_DOC" through POST /admin/agent-evaluations'), section 12 ('Interfaces called: S4 LegalActionQueryService.listByCase(caseId); P5 DocumentQueryService.listByCase, getFields and getChecklist(caseType)') and section 13 ('Feature flag: rwb.agent.legal-shadow'); TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1 (the eight agent tables), T3.2 (LOV-AGENT, LOV-AUTONOMY, LOV-CONFIG-STATUS, LOV-EVAL-STATUS, LOV-SUBJECT-TYPE) and T-A.1 (eleven operations, none of them a run start); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 16 (rwb-agent IN: GET /agent-runs/{id}; TMP AgentRunWorkflow: 60 s, then rule result; OUT: rwb.agent.events.v1: AgentRunCompleted), slide 41 (schema rwb_agent, one login per service), slide 43 row 28 (EV-28 producer rwb-agent) and slide 44 (no job for the agent); Ownership Map v1 (document, document_field, document_checklist_item owner P5, legal_action owner S4, eight agent tables owner P10); Template and Rules v1 §R3 default ruling (feature flags to the platform library) and §R5.5 DP-01, DP-02, DP-06, DP-07, DP-09, DP-13 and DP-19
area: Legal document agent in shadow: identity, run path, parameters, legal-action read, events, flag, checklist source and route
owner_role: Solution architect with the P10 service owner and the owners of rwb-case, rwb-document and rwb-litigation
proposed: Name the login 'the rwb-agent login (DP-02)' until the platform agrees the string; fix the run start as `POST /agent-runs` below the base; read the minimum scored sample and the promotion check list through the rwb-case parameters operation with one hop and the 2 s budget; read the legal action through an operation of rwb-litigation that is faked here and proved by the integration copy, with no C row added; add the two event names on the same topic and subject; keep the feature flag as a platform-library row; read the checklist through the rwb-document contract, because `document_checklist_item` is P5's; reach the reads through the gateway-bff route. Every value is settled in the assumption rows cited and no literal is invented.

title: The contract slice of the legal document agent in shadow: the run-start path and request members, the member types of the proposal payload, the two added event names, the consumed paths no source names, the parameter codes, the missing S4 contract row and the route name are not specified by any source
source: Legacy RWB-E2-030 sections 7 and 12 to 14; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.9; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1, T3.2, T5.2, T5.3 and T-A.1 to T-A.2; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13, 16, 22, 41, 42 and 43; Ownership Map v1 (the P10 operations, the eight agent tables, EV-28, the P5 document tables and the S4 legal_action); Template and Rules v1 §R4, §R5.5 and §R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 5 Exception paths; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC8; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.2; 12.3; 12.7; 12.8; 19 Out of scope
description: Six elements of the contract are open in the sources. (1) The legacy story names the in-process harness and no run-start operation, so the path below the base and the request members are fixed by the document and not by a source. (2) The legacy `legal-pack-v1` object gives member names only (items with itemCode, status, documentIds and defectReason, and confidence); the type and length of documentIds, fieldKeys and sourceRef and the member name of the defect reason beyond the legacy wording are stated by no source. (3) EV-28 AgentRunCompleted is the only event the sources name on the agent topic; the family pattern admits a started member and a pack-proposal member and no source names either. (4) The rwb-document reads this key consumes are named by the P5 baseline rather than by a source for this key, and the by-case legal-action read of rwb-litigation has no published operation; the key's C list carries no S4 contract story. (5) The parameter codes of the minimum scored sample and of the promotion check list are not named. (6) The gateway-bff route in front of the two operations has no name and no path. The contract keeps every legacy member, fixes the element names and carries one assumption per default.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-030 section 12 ('POST /api/recovery/v1/admin/agent-samples, POST /api/recovery/v1/admin/agent-evaluations, GET /api/recovery/v1/admin/agent-evaluations (new, RWB-E1-058)', 'Output schema "legal-pack-v1": items (array of {itemCode from the checklist, status PRESENT, MISSING or DEFECT, documentIds, defectReason}), confidence', 'Interfaces called: S4 LegalActionQueryService.listByCase(caseId); P5 DocumentQueryService.listByCase, getFields and getChecklist(caseType)', 'Event published: EV-28 AgentRunCompleted') and section 14 (MSG-P10-001, MSG-P10-002, MSG-P7-002, MSG-P4-002); TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1 (DF-AGT-036 to DF-AGT-060, the agent_run fields the payload uses), T3.2 (the lists) and T5.3 (AgentRunCompleted published); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 16 (rwb-agent IN: GET /agent-runs/{id}; OUT: rwb.agent.events.v1: AgentRunCompleted), slide 11 (REST one hop 2 s; Kafka retry and .dlt) and slide 42 note (CloudEvents, key caseId, BACKWARD compatibility); Ownership Map v1 (document, document_field and document_checklist_item owner P5; legal_action owner S4; EV-28 owner P10); Recovery Workbench P5 E2025 contract (the documents, fields and checked-fields reads of the hub); Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-01, DP-06, DP-07, DP-09, DP-13 and DP-19
area: Contract: operation paths, payload member types, event family, boundary paths and route name
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-agent with the solution architect and the owners of rwb-case, rwb-document and rwb-litigation
proposed: Fix the run start as `POST /agent-runs` with the six request members and the 409 repeat; fix the proposal member names from the legacy `legal-pack-v1` object and leave their types to the review with the document and data-steward owners; declare EV-28 as catalogued and add the started and pack-proposal members on the same topic and subject; name the three rwb-document reads of RWB-P5-E2025-CON and fake the by-case legal-action read with no C row added; read the parameter rows through the rwb-case operation; declare the route as a pass-through of one hop whose name is agreed with the route contract. The app story, the P5 sibling story and the integration copy build against these shapes and the fakes.
